purpose: Metadata-only clean-room planning inventory. No ROM bytes, geometry, textures, asset hashes, binary offsets or extracted payloads.

source.licenseNote: The parser source project declares MIT. That licence does not grant rights to any commercial game assets or extracted payloads. This file preserves only names and IDs from public metadata.

mappingRules: Racer fields Podd, MAlt, Pupp, Lod1 and Lod2 are logical ModelBlockItem catalogue references, not physical N64 block indices.

Racer model physical indices were resolved by joining each canonical ModelBlockItem name to exactly one item in the N64 USA model block map. All non-null racer model references have a unique exact-name match in this snapshot.

Track.Model is a logical model catalogue reference. This pass resolves a physical N64 index only when the N64 block's item-value name exactly matches the canonical catalogue name; unresolved aliases are retained as unresolved, not treated as missing tracks.
BlockItem.Index is the physical item index within the selected block; BlockItem.ValueId is a metadata value ID. Neither is interchangeable with a ModelBlockItem logical reference.
The upstream TrakModelFormatTester.cs explicitly marks its Track lookup as a TODO because lookup by model metadata ID fails for values such as 1001. This is a known alias/mapping limitation.

regionalComparison.note: Counts and names are derived from Release.csv, Block.csv and BlockItem.csv at the pinned metadata revision. A physical-index name comparison uses the mapped ModelBlockItem/ SpriteBlockItem ValueId record.

modelMappingComparison.interpretation: The public metadata maps the same model names to the same physical indices in the USA and shared Europe/Japan N64 model blocks. Do not create separate regional model catalogues unless a binary/runtime check contradicts this metadata.

spriteMappingComparison.interpretation: Sprite indices/content differ by region. The Europe release points to the shared _default sprite block in Release.csv; it is not labeled as a dedicated N64 Europe sprite block.
